description.value: A southern Gulf Islands marine park on Galiano Island's southwest shore with white shell beaches, tidal lagoons, glacially-carved rock ledges, ancient Indigenous middens, and 130+ bird species; reaching it requires a BC Ferries crossing, then a 10 km paved ride from Sturdies Bay terminal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record explicitly tags this campground as first-come, first-served with no reservations (reservation: no), no showers (shower: no), drinking water (drinking_water: yes), and no power supply (power_supply: no); the site name itself confirms the no-reservation nature. The BC Parks website corroborates walk-in campsites at the park on Galiano Island accessible via BC Ferries, and the frontcountry camping page confirms that non-reservable sites operate first-come, first-served. No hiker/biker-specific designation, food, shelter, or other amenity details appear explicitly in the website text, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chemainus' but the park is on Galiano Island — likely a geographic tagging error.
OSM name includes the operational descriptor 'First-come, first-served' rather than the official park name 'Montague Harbour Marine Park'; this may cause confusion in directory listings.
No address or phone number in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active BC Parks provincial campground on Galiano Island with walk-in sites well-suited to touring cyclists on the Gulf Islands ferry circuit; the first-come, first-served designation is particularly relevant to cycle tourists.

wow_evidence: white shell beaches, tidal lagoons, glacially-carved rock ledges, ancient Indigenous middens, and 130+ bird species
